title: [Decision] cloud: sample rows an app install seeds on a hosted environment may have no owner — apply #30324's rule (owner = the installer, ordinary permissions, no exception)
body:
repo:cloud#3 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjRhUZjdy8VXs6Kkur2

Ruled: 6673940208 · letter A · 2026-11-06T01:12Z
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/cloud#3644

domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyvF7SP65frVFAYLv7

Filing gate: ② a decision only the maintainer can make, filed on the maintainer's direct word (③), verbatim: 「写一个 cloud 车道的决策卡，带上我的意见 cloud 车道也有类似的问题。」 (2026-11-05, Claude Code project "Objectstack", thread 「Server 车道派发(席5 #28677)」). Analysis-tier: seat tier (this seat's session default).
Reader: the `repo:cloud` seat (cloud PM). This seat cannot read the cloud repository, so the premise below is unmeasured on the cloud side and is the cloud seat's first step.
Dedupe: `is:issue label:repo:cloud seed` (9 hits, none on seed ownership), `is:issue seed owner_id created_by install` (41 hits; the only match is #30324, this card's objectstack twin). **New.**

## 维护者速读

在 objectstack 本仓，应用安装时写入的示例数据没有负责人和创建人，同事打开应用什么都看不到。你在 #30324 上已经定了：示例数据写入时负责人、创建人就是执行安装的管理员，之后完全按平台统一的权限规则走，不为示例数据破例；私有共享下同事看不到也接受。你说 cloud 车道也有类似问题，本卡把同一条规则交给 cloud 车道：cloud 侧凡是在安装或开通环境时写入示例数据的地方，都要带上安装人作为负责人和创建人，不加任何示例数据专用的权限规则。我建议 **A**，与你在 #30324 的意见一致。

## The question

When the hosted platform (cloud) installs an app into a customer's environment and seeds its sample data, who owns those rows, and do they get any special visibility?

Governing text:
- The maintainer's ruling on the objectstack twin, recorded on #30324 as comment 6670861426, verbatim: 「HotCRM 是私有共享，记录的主人是管理员，同事照样看不到，这个按照平台同意的权限规则就可以。」 and 「我不认为需要为了事例数据破例。」
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/claim-seed-ownership.ts` (objectstack `main` `b77c160a`), header: boot seeds land with `owner_id = NULL` or `usr_system`, so "owner-keyed UX — 'My' views, owner reports, owner notifications — is empty out of the box"; the platform hands boot-seeded rows to the first platform admin. The same header says the marketplace install's seed is NOT covered by that pass, which is the gap #30324 closes on the objectstack side.
- Protocol: no spec change is expected (the rows already carry `owner_id` / `created_by`); if the cloud side finds one is needed, that is a `domain:spec` card first.

## Premise to measure first (cloud seat)

- Which cloud doors seed sample or demo rows into a customer environment: the hosted marketplace install, environment provisioning, a template or blueprint publish that seeds records, any reseed or replay. Re-check: in the cloud repository, search the seed and install paths for writes of seed datasets, then read one seeded row's `owner_id` and `created_by` on a hosted environment after an install.
- Whether those rows land ownerless (`NULL` or `usr_system`) the way the objectstack marketplace install does today (#30324 measured: the installer reads 11 accounts, a member 0, `owner_id` and `created_by` empty).
- If no cloud door seeds ownerless rows, this card closes with that reading.

## Options

| Option | What it does | What the customer sees | Work |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A. Owner = the installer, ordinary rules (the maintainer's stated position)** | Every cloud seeding door writes `owner_id` and `created_by` as the person who ran the install or provisioning; nothing else changes | The installer owns the demo data and sees it in "My" views and owner reports. Under `private` sharing, colleagues see it only as they would any real record | Cloud lane, one PR per seeding door family; precedent: #30324 (objectstack side, in flight) and `claim-seed-ownership.ts` |
| **B. A sample-data read rule** | Mark seeded rows and let holders of the app's permission read them | Colleagues see the demo data read-only | Cloud + server + security lanes; rejected on #30324 by the maintainer |
| **C. Leave the rows ownerless** | No change | Demo data visible only to administrators; owner views and reports empty | None |

In business terms: A treats demo data like data an admin typed in. B is a special showroom pass. C leaves the demo data with nobody's name on it.

## Recommendation: A

四轴（中文）：

- **项目长远合理性：** 示例数据和真实数据走同一套权限规则，平台里没有第二种记录。objectstack 侧 #30324 已按此执行，cloud 侧照做，两边一致。
- **实际业务需求：** 管理员装好应用后，自己的"我的记录"、按负责人的报表都能看到演示数据；同事是否可见由应用自己的共享设置决定，和真实数据一样，客户不会被一套只对演示数据生效的规则搞糊涂。
- **防 AI 写代码犯错：** 没有特例就没有特例的边角（#30324 里就出现过"示例主记录下的真实明细被同事看到"这种静默泄露风险）。出错时谁看到什么，只取决于平台统一规则。
- **创业阶段不扩散：** 不加新权限路径、不加新配置，只是在写入时补上本该有的两个字段。

Blind spot: this seat has not read the cloud code, so the number of cloud seeding doors and whether any already stamps an owner are unknown.

只看①选 A；②③④ 是否翻转：否。

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性: A removes a special case; demo rows become ordinary records under one permission model, same as the objectstack side (#30324).
② 实际业务拉动: the installer's owner views and reports are empty today on the objectstack side (measured on #30324); cloud premise unmeasured.
③ 防 AI 犯错: no sample-only access path, so no silent widening; visibility follows the one platform rule.
④ 创业阶段不扩散: no new key, rule or gate; two fields written at seed time.

## After the ruling

The cloud seat measures the premise, then dispatches the seeding doors it finds, each stamping the installer as owner and creator, pinned on a hosted environment. No sample-data permission rule is added. Related: #30324 (objectstack twin, in flight under this seat).

Blocks nothing.
